# ASTM International

> ASTM International develops and publishes consensus-based standards for materials, products, systems, and services across numerous industries.

ASTM International is a globally recognized standards development organization. The site provides information about career opportunities, company culture, and employment at the organization.

## Key Topics

- ASTM International
- Standards Development
- Careers and Employment
- Company Culture
- Accessibility
- Standards Organization
- Job Opportunities

## Employment and Careers

- [Careers At ASTM International](https://www.astm.org/about/careers): Job opportunities and employment information at ASTM International
